concepts.definition: A selection of TCGA primary-tumour patients for studies of tumour heterogeneity: assay-quality exclusions, a patient treatment and diagnosis screen, histology-defined and pooled cohorts, and a minimum cohort size of 150 patients with RNA-seq or 450k and 100 with both.
What each TCGA project provides after assay-quality exclusions only, before the patient screen and histology selection. It is larger than the selected panel and must not be mixed with it.

The unit of the selected panel: usually one TCGA project; CRC pools TCGA-COAD and TCGA-READ, GLIOMA pools TCGA-LGG and TCGA-GBM, and ESCC, PDAC and CSCC are histology-defined cohorts within TCGA-ESCA, TCGA-PAAD and TCGA-CESC. Each patient belongs to one cohort.
The pooled glioma cohort (TCGA-LGG and TCGA-GBM), used to test whether a molecular target recovers historical or integrated WHO CNS5 diagnoses. Integrated diagnoses are not adjudicated.

A review of treatment, diagnosis, identity and recurrence annotations for every retained TCGA patient. It withholds patients by exclusion or reversible hold and never changes assay states. Withheld patients do not form a treated reference set.

Unique patients with a retained primary-tumour assay: the union of RNA-seq and 450k, the intersection (both, or paired) and the single-assay remainders. Patients with both assays also appear in each single-assay column.
TCGA patients with same-sample normal RNA-seq and an H&E image (and, where counted, normal 450k). Normal tissue comes from patients with cancer, not healthy donors.
A published spatial omics study or vendor example with matched H&E. Spatial studies come from patients other than those in TCGA.
The original H&E image, measured expression and spot or cell coordinates were found for a resource. Image registration and tissue QC may still be pending.
One assayed section or capture area with its own expression matrix, coordinates and H&E image (a capture). Repeated or serial sections add sections, not patients.
Located tissue sections in the core tier (primary tumour within a defined histology stratum) documented as untreated before sampling.

Counts in a study's own units (sections, slides, samples, donor labels) for resources not verified at section level. They are not patient counts unless stated, are never added across studies, and an unknown count is absent, not zero.

The minimum cohort size of the selected panel: at least 150 patients with a primary-tumour RNA-seq or 450k methylation profile and at least 100 with both, counted after assay-quality exclusions and before the patient screen. It applies to analysis cohorts, not TCGA projects; ESCC (90 patients) and PDAC (149) are explicit exceptions, and TCGA-SARC is not in the panel because each of its sarcoma types is below the threshold.
A cancer page combining others (CRC from COAD and READ, GLIOMA from LGG and GBM). It reuses the resources of its constituent cancers, so its counts must not be added to theirs.
